name: sprite-gen
tagline_zh: 从角色设定到动画图集，一条流水线全自动。告别手抠图、乱命名、帧错位，连QA报告和运行时清单都替你备好。
tagline_en: From character spec to animation atlas, one pipeline. No more manual cutouts, messy names, or misaligned.
desc_en: Generate clean 2D game sprites and animation atlases with a component-row pipeline: base identity, numeric sprite-request SSoT, per-state layout guides, image-gen row strips, chroma-key alpha cleanup, connected-component frame extraction, cell-based atlas composition, QA reports, and runtime manifest frame_layout. why_zh: 同类工具只出图，它却把“数字请求、布局指南、抠图、切帧、拼图、QA”串成一条可复用的组件链。
why_en: Others just generate images; this chains numeric specs, layout guides, keying, frame extraction, atlas packing, and QA into one.
